text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Kuuugh...! Aaaaargh, this is so 
frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I should've been able to hold on better 
at the end...! And my timing to make a 
move was off too...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, there's no point in saying anything 
now. —Congratulations, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You really are strong, McQueen. But next 
time, I definitely won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's have another serious showdown again, 
without fail!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! This is not where it ends.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Next time we face each other, neither of 
us will hold back—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us have another serious showdown like 
today's!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Once the Kikuka Sho is over, there's very 
little left of this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And once the new year arrives, it won't be 
long...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"This is the race I have made my ultimate 
goal. —I shall surely show you the 
culmination of everything I am."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen burned with fighting 
spirit. Her eyes gazed earnestly toward 
the future.
